title: Pacing model development in an era of cyber-critical capabilities
summary: OpenAI is strengthening monitoring, alignment, and security for frontier AI models. See how new safeguards are guiding the pace of model development.
body: OpenAI is strengthening monitoring, alignment, and security for frontier AI models. See how new safeguards are guiding the pace of model development.
summaryZh: OpenAI官方发布公告，宣布正在全面加强前沿AI模型的监控、对齐机制以及安全性建设。文章深入阐述了新的安全防护措施如何直接指导和调控模型开发的整体节奏，确保在追求更强大能力的同时，有效防范网络安全等潜在系统性风险，体现了业界对负责任AI开发的持续重视。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI官方关于前沿模型安全监控与对齐的开发节奏调整，对整个人工智能行业的安全合规路线具风向标意义。
